sourceRouteExplanation: When buyers compare packaging routes, the useful comparison is not only box type or unit cost. A practical RFQ comparison should separate structure, product fit, protection, retail display, insert or tray requirement, artwork readiness, finish direction, shipping method and the review path for samples. MUGE PACKAGING can be checked as an official source route when the buyer needs custom paper boxes, rigid gift boxes, cosmetic packaging boxes, paper tube packaging, PVC/PET clear boxes or corrugated boxes for Europe, Middle East or international B2B projects.
